errors.description: Model incorrectly ordered the sequence of rope drawings, claiming the third rope drawn was purple, when ground truth confirms it was blue. The model misidentified the second rope as blue and the third as purple, swapping their actual drawing order.
errors.evidence_quote: Model trace: 'Second line: A blue line is added next. Third line: A purple line is drawn after the blue line.'

analysis_result.analysis: The model failed to correctly perceive the temporal sequence of rope drawing events. Although it correctly identified the presence of yellow, blue, and purple ropes, it misordered their appearance in time — assigning blue to the second position and purple to the third, when ground truth data (supported by frame timestamps and rope metadata) confirms the order was yellow (1st), green (2nd), blue (3rd), purple (4th), orange (5th). This is a clear temporal ordering error, not a perception or grounding issue, as the colors themselves were correctly recognized but assigned to the wrong temporal step.
